freePlan.limits: Overlays, chatbot, alerts, and a merch store with limited sizes and designs; 1 user, 1 project, 1 GB storage per third-party tracker

keyLimits.en: Overlays, chatbot, alerts, and a merch store with limited sizes and designs; 1 user, 1 project, 1 GB storage per third-party tracker
More merch sizes/designs and overlay options, 5 users, 5 projects, 10 GB storage per third-party tracker; not confirmed on the official pricing page in this session.
Unlimited users/projects, 100 GB storage, priority support per third-party tracker; not confirmed on the official pricing page in this session.

cautions.en: The official streamelements.com/plus pricing page could not be retrieved with full content in this session; prices above come from a third-party listing and should be reverified against the primary source.

capabilities.en: Cloud-based stream overlay editor with customizable alerts and widgets.
Stream chatbot with moderation and custom commands.
Integrated merch store (SE.Merch) and tipping/donation system, no subscription required to start.
Loyalty program with stream currency viewers can earn and spend.

limitations.en: Free plan caps merch design/size options and overlay features compared to paid tiers.
Some features (larger storage, more projects/users) require a paid plan starting around 10 USD/month.

reason.en: Direct competitor offering the same overlay/alerts/chatbot toolkit for streamers.
Free broadcasting software StreamElements integrates with; some streamers use OBS's native tools instead of StreamElements overlays.

unknowns: Exact current paid plan pricing and feature breakdown were not confirmed on the official streamelements.com pricing page in this session; figures come from a third-party source.
Catalogue lacks enough direct StreamElements competitors beyond Streamlabs for a full 3-6 alternative list.
